entries.title: Jeremiah 12:1
segments: ¶Righteous [art] thou, O LORD, when I plead with thee: yet let me talk with thee of [thy] judgments: Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper? [wherefore] are all they happy that deal very treacherously? {talk...: or, reason the case with thee}

words.text: with thee: yet let me talk
? {talk...: or, reason the case with thee}

entries.title: Jeremiah 12:2
segments: Thou hast planted them, yea, they have taken root: they grow, yea, they bring forth fruit: thou [art] near in their mouth, and far from their reins. {they grow: Heb. they go on}

words.text: them, yea, they have taken root

entries.title: Jeremiah 12:3
segments: But thou, O LORD, knowest me: thou hast seen me, and tried mine heart toward thee: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter. {toward...: Heb. with thee}

entries.title: Jeremiah 12:4
segments: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of every field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein? the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our last end.

entries.title: Jeremiah 12:5
segments: If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and [if] in the land of peace, [wherein] thou trustedst, [they wearied thee], then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?

words.text: thee, then how canst thou contend
, [they wearied thee], then how wilt thou do

entries.title: Jeremiah 12:6
segments: For even thy brethren, and the house of thy father, even they have dealt treacherously with thee; yea, they have called a multitude after thee: believe them not, though they speak fair words unto thee. {they have called...: or, they cried after thee fully} {fair...: Heb. good things}

words.text: with thee; yea, they have called
unto thee. {they have called...: or, they cried after thee fully} {fair...: Heb. good things}

entries.title: Jeremiah 12:7
segments: ¶I have forsaken mine house, I have left mine heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies. {the dearly...: Heb. the love}

entries.title: Jeremiah 12:8
segments: Mine heritage is unto me as a lion in the forest; it crieth out against me: therefore have I hated it. {crieth...: or, yelleth: Heb. giveth out his voice}

words.text: is unto me as a lion
against me: therefore have I hated
it. {crieth...: or, yelleth: Heb. giveth out his voice}

entries.title: Jeremiah 12:9
segments: Mine heritage [is] unto me [as] a speckled bird, the birds round about [are] against her; come ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour. {speckled: or, taloned} {come to: or, cause them to come to}

words.text: . {speckled: or, taloned} {come to: or, cause them to come to}

entries.title: Jeremiah 12:10
segments: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness. {pleasant...: Heb. portion of desire}

entries.title: Jeremiah 12:11
segments: They have made it desolate, [and being] desolate it mourneth unto me; the whole land is made desolate, because no man layeth [it] to heart.

entries.title: Jeremiah 12:12
segments: The spoilers are come upon all high places through the wilderness: for the sword of the LORD shall devour from the [one] end of the land even to the [other] end of the land: no flesh shall have peace.

entries.title: Jeremiah 12:13
segments: They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns: they have put themselves to pain, [but] shall not profit: and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the LORD. {they shall: or, ye shall}

words.text: : they have put themselves to pain

entries.title: Jeremiah 12:14
segments: ¶Thus saith the LORD against all mine evil neighbours, that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit; Behold, I will pluck them out of their land, and pluck out the house of Judah from among them.

words.text: which I have caused my people
; Behold, I will pluck them out

entries.title: Jeremiah 12:15
segments: And it shall come to pass, after that I have plucked them out I will return, and have compassion on them, and will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.

words.text: And it shall come to pass, after
that I have plucked them out
on them, and will bring them again

entries.title: Jeremiah 12:16
segments: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, The LORD liveth; as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built in the midst of my people.

words.text: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently

entries.title: Jeremiah 12:17
segments: But if they will not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation, saith the LORD.
